title: 3 倒计时03
content_zh:
看见两人的神情，保洁阿姨也意识到自己似乎无意中捅破了什么秘密，推着她的吸尘器忙不迭走了。
留倪夏和谷雨声坐在沙发上面面相觑，眼神从最初的惊诧，逐渐流转为震撼。
“那他这是干嘛？”谷雨声回头看了眼身后，确定没有别人，才问道，“……暗恋你吗？”
倪夏并非从不和异性打交道的人，这几年也见惯了圈子里形形色色的男女。
在这个连表情包都能暴露情感状态的信息时代，不管暗恋还是明恋，喜欢一个人是一定会有信号释放的。
谷雨声抓心挠肝的，实在坐不住，朝着游决办公室的方向抬了抬下巴。
她们清清楚楚看见沙发上，还真放着一幅五十多寸、以胡桃木装裱的画。
但露出的背景色块明显是黑棕色建筑一角，很像倪夏前几年用作微信头像的照片。
自从做独立电影以来，倪夏和谷雨声大大小小的老板见了不少，高伙级别的律师还是第一次见。
两人都想表现得云淡风轻游刃有余，却又都在见到徐绍心的那一刻差点喊出“老师好”。
齐肩短发、素面朝天，还戴着一副厚重的框架眼镜，活脱脱就是一个中学教导主任。
特别是当她打量倪夏时，倪夏当场就想找面镜子检查自己的仪容仪表。
感觉到倪夏的拘谨，徐绍心说道：“别紧张，我应该和你父母差不多大，叫我‘徐阿姨’也行的。”
没想到徐绍心不仅很好说话，连眼神也带着几分慈爱，确实给人一种面对亲近长辈的安全感。
而且随着交谈的深入，倪夏发现徐绍心不仅能抓住她们话里的每一个关键点，还能用通俗易懂的比喻解释复杂的法律概念，让她们清楚自己到底是在什么样的境地中。
不仅如此，徐绍心甚至还指出了这份投资合同里好几个“软条款”陷阱，在此之前倪夏和谷雨声从未察觉过。
两人火气一上来，两张小嘴就像机关枪似的说不停，到后面几乎是慷慨激昂地控诉中悦汇投不做人。
“不用着急，这些问题咱们都可以一个个解决。”徐绍心不急不缓地说，“你们接下来要做的事情是系统地整理所有相关证据。”
“是这样，”徐绍心换了个坐姿，双手交握搭在办公桌上，笑着说道，“我马上要去国外出差，所以先由我团队的另一位律师来负责这个案件，你们看怎么样？”
content_en:
Seeing the expressions on the two of them, the cleaning lady also realized that she seemed to have revealed some secret unintentionally, and hurriedly left while pushing her vacuum cleaner.
Ni Xia and Gu Yusheng were left sitting on the sofa, looking at each other, their eyes gradually changing from surprise to shock.
"Then what is he doing?" Gu Yusheng looked behind him to make sure there was no one else, then asked, "...has a crush on you?"
Ni Xia is not someone who never interacts with the opposite sex. In the past few years, she has become accustomed to seeing all kinds of men and women in the circle.
In this information age where even emoticons can reveal your emotional state, no matter whether you have a crush or a clear love, if you like someone, there will definitely be a signal released.
Gu Yusheng was scratching his head. He couldn't sit still and raised his chin in the direction of You Jue's office.
They clearly saw that there was actually a fifty-inch painting framed in walnut on the sofa.
But the exposed background color block is obviously a corner of a black-brown building, which is very similar to the photo that Ni Xia used as a WeChat avatar a few years ago.
Since making independent films, Ni Xia and Gu Yusheng have met many bosses, big and small, and this is the first time they have met a high-level lawyer.
Both of them wanted to show that Yun Danfeng was at ease, but they almost shouted "Hello, teacher" the moment they saw Xu Shaoxin.
With short shoulder-length hair, a bare face, and a pair of thick-framed glasses, he looks like a middle school dean.
Especially when she looked at Ni Xia, Ni Xia immediately wanted to find a mirror to check her appearance.
Feeling Ni Xia's restraint, Xu Shaoxin said: "Don't be nervous, I should be about the same age as your parents, you can just call me 'Aunt Xu'."
Unexpectedly, Xu Shaoxin was not only easy to talk to, but also had a kind of loving look in her eyes, which really gave people a sense of security when facing close elders.
And as the conversation deepened, Ni Xia discovered that Xu Shaoxin could not only grasp every key point in their words, but also explain complex legal concepts with easy-to-understand metaphors, so that they could understand what kind of situation they were in.
Not only that, Xu Shaoxin even pointed out several "soft clauses" traps in the investment contract, which Ni Xia and Gu Yusheng had never noticed before.
When the two of them got angry, they kept talking like machine guns. Later, they almost impassionedly accused Zhongyue Huitou of being a bad person.
"Don't worry, we can solve these problems one by one." Xu Shao said calmly, "The next thing you have to do is to systematically sort out all the relevant evidence."
"That's right," Xu Shaoxin changed her sitting position, clasped her hands on the desk, and said with a smile, "I'm going on a business trip abroad soon, so another lawyer from my team will be responsible for this case first. What do you think?"
